answer: One defense is a rotating audit lottery: each week the network randomly pairs identities to re-check each other's completed work, and an identity that fails an audit loses its bond and its standing. A fake farm must therefore keep convincing work histories for every puppet consistent under random re-checks, which costs nearly as much as honest work. The tide of new registrations is throttled because each identity must first complete a copper deposit of service before it can vote or vouch, and jade standing is earned only from audits passed, never bought, so numbers alone buy no influence.
